_about: Editorial layer for the DDM deal feed. Network facts (terms, dates, tracking URL) come from CJ link-search on DDM property 101511733 and are merged in by refresh_deals.py. Everything here is written by us: display merchant, category, value parse used by the Deal Score, and the AI-written summary. Summaries may only use numbers that appear in the network terms (enforced by tests/ddm-redesign.test.mjs).

deals.title: Up to 25% off select countertop appliances
deals.summary_ai: KitchenAid's Harvest Event takes up to 25% off select countertop appliances on kitchenaid.com, no code needed. Closeout, commercial and refurbished models are excluded, and "up to" means many models get less, so compare the cart price.

deals.title: Up to $120 off select stand mixers
deals.summary_ai: Select KitchenAid stand mixers are up to $120 off during the Harvest Event. It applies to new orders on kitchenaid.com only; check which mixer models carry the full discount before you pick a size.

deals.title: Up to 35% off select food processors
deals.summary_ai: The deepest percentage in the Harvest Event: up to 35% off select KitchenAid food processors. Same exclusions as the main sale (no closeout, commercial or refurbished models).

deals.title: Up to $250 off select coffee machines
deals.summary_ai: KitchenAid lists up to $250 off select coffee products in the Harvest Event. The biggest dollar figure usually applies to the priciest espresso models, so check the saving on the exact machine you want.

deals.title: Up to 30% off select stand mixer attachments
deals.summary_ai: Already own a KitchenAid mixer? Select attachments are up to 30% off in the Harvest Event, which can be a cheaper upgrade than a new mixer.

deals.title: Up to 50% off select refurbished appliances
deals.summary_ai: KitchenAid's refurbished sale lists up to 50% off select refurbished countertop appliances. It can't be combined with other offers and excludes in-home delivery products; check the refurbished warranty before buying.

deals.title: Free delivery and 60-day returns
deals.summary_ai: An ongoing store policy rather than a sale: KitchenAid advertises free delivery and 60-day returns on kitchenaid.com, with restrictions and exclusions. Useful when comparing it with other sellers.

deals.title: $100 off the Compact Steam Pro steam station
deals.summary_ai: Rowenta lists $100 off its Compact Steam Pro professional-grade steam station, a short sale valid Oct 8-Oct 11, 2026. It's a single-product offer, so compare the final price with other retailers.

deals.title: $40 off the Freemove Force cordless steam iron
deals.summary_ai: The Rowenta Freemove Force cordless steam iron is $40 off on rowentausa.com, valid Oct 6-Oct 19, 2026. One product, no code listed in the network terms.

deals.title: Up to $84 off fans
deals.summary_ai: Rowenta fans are up to $84 off through Oct 31, 2026, from desk fans to outdoor models. The top figure applies to specific models, so check the one you want.

deals.title: Free shipping on orders $99.99+
deals.summary_ai: T-fal.com ships free on orders of $99.99 and above. Worth knowing if you are close to that total; not worth padding a cart for.

deals.title: 20% off your first order with email sign-up
deals.summary_ai: T-fal offers 20% off a first order when you join its newsletter. You trade your email address for the discount, and it only applies once.

deals.title: 5% off sitewide
deals.summary_ai: An affiliate-exclusive 5% off sitewide at Peets.com, including subscriptions (limited to 3 recurring payments). No minimum, one use per customer, and it combines with shipping discounts.

deals.title: Free shipping on orders $49+
deals.summary_ai: Peets.com gives free ground shipping on orders over $49 within the continental US, applied automatically at checkout.

deals.title: 30% off a new coffee subscription
deals.summary_ai: 30% off the first order of a new Peet's coffee subscription. It applies to the first order only, so check the regular subscription price you'll pay after that.

deals.title: One World Observatory NYC: up to 50% off
deals.summary_ai: A Groupon flash sale on One World Observatory tickets in New York, up to 50% off for a limited time. Groupon lists it for the NYC, New Jersey and Philadelphia-area markets; read the voucher's fine print and dates.

deals.title: View Boston Observation Deck: up to 40% off
deals.summary_ai: Up to 40% off View Boston Observation Deck tickets through Groupon, a limited-time flash sale aimed at Boston and nearby Northeast markets. Check the voucher's valid dates before buying.

deals.title: Aquarium of the Pacific: up to 33% off tickets
deals.summary_ai: Up to 33% off Aquarium of the Pacific (Long Beach, CA) tickets on Groupon. Listed for Southern California markets; compare with the aquarium's own ticket price first.

deals.title: Costco membership with a $20 or $40 shop card
deals.summary_ai: A one-year Costco membership through Groupon that includes a $20 or $40 Digital Costco Shop Card, extended through Oct 25. It's not eligible for Groupon's sitewide promo codes.

deals.title: BJ's Wholesale Club membership for $10
deals.summary_ai: Groupon lists a BJ's Wholesale Club membership for just $10. Check what membership tier it covers and whether it renews at full price.

deals.title: AMF, Lucky Strike and Bowlero bowling from $29 for 2
deals.summary_ai: Bowling at AMF, Lucky Strike and Bowlero via Groupon, with AMF starting at $29 for 2 people across 300+ locations. Groupon says it's eligible for sitewide promo codes.

deals.title: 40% off Regal movie tickets
deals.summary_ai: Save 40% on Regal movie tickets through Groupon, including Premiere and premium-format tickets, plus a discount on popcorn and snacks. Check which theaters and formats your voucher covers.

deals.title: Up to 30% off closeouts
deals.summary_ai: Sockwell's closeout section is up to 30% off, no code required. Closeouts mean limited sizes and colors.

deals.title: Free shipping on orders $75+
deals.summary_ai: Free shipping on Sockwell orders of $75 or more, no code required.

deals.title: 30% off flea and tick protection + free shipping
deals.summary_ai: Budget Pet Care's 10.10 sale takes 30% off flea and tick protection with free shipping when you use the code. Make sure the product and dose match your pet's weight and your vet's advice.

deals.title: Chuck E. Cheese: up to 43% off
deals.summary_ai: Up to 43% off Chuck E. Cheese through Groupon vouchers. The top discount applies to select vouchers, so compare the voucher price with paying at the counter and check which locations accept it.

deals.title: Escapology private escape room: up to 40% off
deals.summary_ai: Up to 40% off a private escape room at Escapology, sold as a Groupon voucher. Check that your nearest Escapology location is included and read the booking rules before you buy.

deals.title: 10% off loose leaf tea subscriptions + free shipping
deals.summary_ai: 10% off plus free shipping when you subscribe to Mighty Leaf loose leaf tea at peets.com. It only applies to subscriptions, so check the delivery schedule and how to pause or cancel.

deals.title: 20% off your first order
deals.summary_ai: 20% off your first order at SockwellUSA.com with code NEWSOCKS20. First orders only, and Sockwell describes it as a limited-time offer.

deals.title: 10% off at singer.com
deals.summary_ai: 10% off at singer.com with code SEW10NOW. The network terms are short and list no exclusions, so confirm the discount shows in your cart before paying.

deals.title: Free shipping on orders $99.99+
deals.summary_ai: Free shipping on Rowenta orders of $99.99 or more at rowentausa.com, applied without a code.

deals.title: Free shipping at Berkel's US store
deals.summary_ai: Free shipping at Berkel's US online store, according to its affiliate program. The network terms are brief, so confirm shipping is free for your address at checkout.
